title: Relationship Desk Card: Lessee Rate Points on a Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Unpaid Installment Charge
content:
**Relationship desk card.** Customers holding a Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease receive rate points on the late charge for an installment of their Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract left unpaid past its grace period.

**Rule.** When the customer holds an active Kestrel lease (a Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease in active status) and the customer's Kestrel lease ledger shows at least 12 lease payments and no lease late charge in the last 12 calendar months, 0.5 percentage points are taken off the unpaid installment rate; when the customer holds an active Kestrel lease and the lease ledger shows no more than one lease late charge in the last 12 calendar months, where the first condition is not met, 0.25 points are taken off; in every other case no points are taken off.

The points come off the unpaid installment rate that applies to the contract, which is then applied once to the unpaid installment portion.

| Active lease | Lease payments, last 12 calendar months | Lease late charges, last 12 calendar months | Points taken off |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | 12 or more | none | 0.5 |
| yes | 12 or more | one | 0.25 |
| yes | fewer than 12 | none or one | 0.25 |
| yes | any | two or more | 0 |
| no | any | any | 0 |

**Counting.** Lease payments and lease late charges are the entries on the customer's Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease ledger, by their dates. Whole calendar months from one date to a later one are the difference in month numbers, less one when the later date's day number is smaller than the earlier date's, with no month-end adjustment; an entry lies in the last N calendar months when its date is not after today and fewer than N whole months run from its date to today, which is the same as being dated after the same day number N months before today.
